data.name: Bashara
data.gender_notes: Bashara is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘sh-r-‘, meaning ‘good news’ or ‘glad tiding’. In Islamic tradition, the name Bashara is a blessing and a symbol of hope and optimism. The name Bashara carries the meaning “Good news, glad tiding, blessings” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bashara usually hope their child will grow to embody good news, glad tiding, blessings and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name filled with blessings and positive energy, reflecting the Prophet Muhammad’s (pbuh) words, ‘Indeed, the best of all names is Bashar (man) because Allah created Adam in His image.’
data.etymology: Bashara belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Good news, glad tiding, blessings.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bashara total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
